technical_decisions.password: 12..128 JS UTF16 code units; preserve bytes/no trimming; Argon2id64MiB3passes1lane
technical_decisions.email: trim NFKC lowercase then validate normalized email <=254
technical_decisions.keys: Distinct canonical base64url32bytes configured ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET and REFRESH_TOKEN_PEPPER; require when PASSWORD_AUTH_ENABLED=true, no defaults
technical_decisions.role_binding: Customer registration creates onlyCUSTOMER; login app fixed perclient. Requested app cannot grant roles; currentDB role+eligibility rechecked login/refresh/me. Merchant/rider privileges not provisioned publicly; production privileged password-only auth denied until MFA/provisioning packet
technical_decisions.eligibility: Identity-owned authorizedApplication grants for existing privileged accounts; only real synthetic DB fixtures in tests until reviewed operator/onboarding flow. No merchant membership/capability claimed by identity grant
technical_decisions.registration: Returns unverified customer session; never emailverified; duplicate yields bounded ACCOUNT_EXISTS explicit compatibility no enumeration-resistance claim
technical_decisions.refresh: Hash only; atomic rotation and replay revoke entire family incl newest access. Originalapplication preserved. Logout presented token revokes wholefamily, logoutAll ownfamilies
technical_decisions.rate_limit: Real Redis shared atomic counters HMAC opaqueIP/email keys; perIP60/60sec + peraccount10/60sec; hashwork global bounded concurrency2, failclosed on Redis errors. Test configurable lowlimits without weakeningprod. Count each authmutation/alias; one mutation rootfield perrequest; no untrusted forwardedIP
technical_decisions.web: Same-origin POST BFF Origin+Host exact checks boundedbody, hostonly HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Secure __Host-cookies inprod explicit devnames. No tokens in HTML/browserJSON/localStorage. Loginapp serverfixed; merchant/admin registration unavailable. Authenticated account/read and logout, explicit refresh; no invisible distributed refresh races
technical_decisions.mobile: Access memory; refresh ExpoSecureStore endpoint+application scoped. Serialize refresh and logout invalidate in-flight completions. Web-export authentication disabled honestly pending browser-BFF transport; native-device gatepending
technical_decisions.production: Password feature off by default; require explicit opt-in and validkeys. Existing sessions always check account/role/grant DB. Admin/merchant/rider password login failclosed inproduction until MFA/policy reviewed
technical_decisions.application_binding: Refresh input, me and logoutAll require fixed caller application; compare signed session application server-side before authorization or rotation. Session output includes application; clients strictly match fixed app. Logout accepts any presented token only to revoke its family. Memoized authorization cannot cross applications.
